source.publication: 2025 Kentucky Form 740 packet with instructions (Kentucky Department of Revenue), with 2025 Form 740, Schedule M, Schedule P and Schedule ITC
source.section: Form 740 (2025) page 1 lines 5-19 and page 2 lines 20-22 (740_2025.pdf PDF pp.1-2); packet PDF p.13 Line 5, Lines 6-9 (Kentucky AGI), Line 10 'Nonitemizers, enter the standard deduction of $3,270 ... If filing a joint return, only one $3,270 standard deduction is allowed', Line 11, Line 12 'Multiply line 11 by four percent (.04)'; packet PDF p.3 'For 2025, the standard deduction is $3,270' and 'the tax rate for individual income tax is 4%'; Schedule M (2025) PDF p.1 line 9 and PDF p.3 Line 9 Pension Income Exclusion ('100 percent of taxable retirement benefits or $31,110, whichever is less ... for each taxpayer and must be computed independently of your spouse') and Pension Income Exclusion Worksheet Steps 1-3; Schedule P (2025) PDF p.1 flowchart and lines 1-4, PDF p.2 Types of Income Subject to Exclusion; packet PDF p.9 chart item 4; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section B line 1 (taxpayer) and line 5 (spouse) 'If you were 65 on or before 12/31/2025, enter 40'; Form 740 lines 16-18 (line 18: if line 17 is larger than line 16, enter zero); packet PDF p.14 Line 17; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section C Family Size Tax Credit Table (family size one: not over 15,650 100% ... over 20,815 0; family size two: not over 21,150 100% ... over 28,130 0); packet PDF p.26 Worksheet for Computation of Modified Gross Income lines (a)-(j) and Section C family size definitions; packet PDF p.11 Modified Gross Income; packet PDF p.14 Line 20 and Line 21 (MGI 42,760 or less); Form 740 page 2 lines 20-22 (line 21: line 19 times the decimal from Schedule ITC)

worked: Single, 70: private pension 30,000 (under the 31,110 limit, all excluded) and interest 4,000. The tax is under the 40 credit, so the credit stops at the tax. MGI is federal AGI, not Kentucky AGI, so the pension exclusion does not open the Family Size Tax Credit. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 30,000.00 + interest 4,000.00 = 34,000.00. Federal taxable income = 34,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 16,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 740, Filing Status 1 (single). Line 5 federal AGI 34,000.00. Line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 = 34,000.00. Person 0 (Column B) Pension Income Exclusion Worksheet Step 1 line (d) = 30,000.00, 31,110 or less, so Step 2 enters the whole: excludable 30,000.00. Schedule M line 9 excludable retirement income = 30,000.00. Schedule M line 17 total subtractions 30,000.00; Form 740 line 8 30,000.00. Line 9 Kentucky AGI = 34,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 4,000.00. Line 10 standard deduction 3,270.00; line 11 taxable income = 4,000.00 - 3,270.00 = 730.00. Line 12 tax = 730.00 x 0.04 = 29.20; lines 13 and 15 0.00; line 14 and line 16 29.20. Schedule ITC Section B: person 0 (age 70) 40; under-65 persons 0; line 17 = 40.00, larger than line 16, so line 18 = 0.00 and the credit used is 29.20. Line 19 = 0.00. Modified gross income worksheet: (a) 34,000.00; (c) non-Kentucky municipal interest 0.00; (e) 34,000.00; (f) Kentucky AGI 4,000.00; (i) 4,000.00; (j) greater = 34,000.00. Line 20 family size 1 (single, no qualifying children); Schedule ITC Section C table: MGI 34,000.00 is over 20,815, so 0% (.00); line 21 = 0.00 x 0 = 0.00. Line 22 = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00. Credits = 29.20 + 0.00 = 29.20; state income tax 0.00. The form enters whole dollars; expected keeps the formula result to the cent. relief_amounts gives the credit's worksheet figure before the limit to the tax (40.00), as the Utah cases do; credits are limited to 29.20.

verified.note: The first working put the age 65 credit's relief amount at 29.20, limited to the tax. The convention (Utah's cases) is the worksheet figure before that limit, 40.00, as the second working had; credits and tax are unchanged.
